notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:

[h3]New Skin:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dress your crow in a cozy Holiday Sweater to celebrate the season in style.
[/list]

Don’t forget to grab the game during the Winter Sale and experience the chaos like never before!

notes.title: It's here! Bird Simulator 24 is OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Bird Simulator 24[/b] has officially launched on Steam! 🐦💥[/h2]

Step into the feathers of a mischievous crow and dive into a chaotic world full of unique powers and tasty treats. [b]Bird Simulator 24[/b] lets you create your own brand of street mayhem. From [b]pooping on pedestrians[/b] to collecting quirky hats, there’s no end to the fun!

[i]Features:[/i]
[list]
[*] 8 unique skins
[*] 6 hillarious hats + 2 secret ones
[*] 34 Steam achievements
[*] 7 mighty power-ups
[*] 6 golden bread loafs
[*] 2 different stages with distinct gamemodes
[*] and 3 easter eggs...
[/list]
[b]Much more coming soon![/b]

Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long day or push for a new high score, [b]Bird Simulator 24[/b] is here to bring the chaos.

[b] Let the crow chaos begin![/b]
